headline: 5 Michigan deals, $38.2M raised — led by Hantz Ventures - PF III (QP) LLC

top_deals.summary: Hantz Ventures - PF III (QP) LLC, a Southfield-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $36M raise; $36M sold to 88 investors.
Call Up Fund 1, LLC, a Farmington Hills-based investment company, filed a $10M equity and other securities offering under Rule 506(c); $825K sold to 5 investors. (Amended filing.)
Talbot Portage LLC, a Birmingham-based residential real estate company, filed a $5M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $450K sold to 3 investors.
Thermaxis, LLC, a Traverse City-based manufacturing company, filed a $1.5M debt offering under Rule 506(b); $325K sold to 3 investors.
Passage Inc., a Detroit-based technology company, filed a $1.2M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $610K sold to 4 investors.

new_funds.summary: Hantz Ventures - PF III (QP) LLC, a Southfield-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $36M raise; $36M sold to 88 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $38.2M sold across 5 Form D filings this week, down 30% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Call Up Fund 1, LLC (Farmington Hills, Investing) targeting $10M. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $36M raised so far — led by Hantz Ventures - PF III (QP) LLC (Venture Capital Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
Manufacturing & Automotive was the most active sector with 1 of 5 filings (20%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
